response.title: which all in one solar inverter is the quietest
response.answer:
If your top priority is low noise, I would focus on fanless, passively cooled hybrid solar inverters rather than conventional all-in-one off-grid inverters.

The biggest distinction is:

Fanless inverters: Usually nearly silent, apart from possible faint electrical humming.

Temperature-controlled fan inverters: Quiet at low loads, but fans can become noticeable during charging or heavy use.

Always-on fan inverters: Generally the least suitable for installation near living spaces.

An inverter advertised as "quiet" isn't necessarily fanless. The important specification is its noise level in dB(A) under load, not just at idle.

My top pick: Sol-Ark 15K-2P
Shop

Best quiet whole-home candidate

Under 30 dB at 25°C

Sol-Ark's September 2026 datasheet specifies intelligent fan cooling and a noise rating below 30 dB at 77°F. This is exceptionally low on paper for a 15 kW hybrid inverter. 
Sol-Ark
+1

The rating does not establish maximum noise under sustained full load.

A comparison with the popular EG4 model shows a substantial difference in published specifications:
